Model Risk
The Bank defines Model Risk as potential loss that
may occur because of decisions or the risk of
mis-estimation that could be principally based on
the output of models due to errors in the
development, implementation, or use of such
models.

Risk Appetite Statement
The Bank has no appetite for breaches in laws and
regulations related to regulatory non-compliance;
recognising that whilst incidents are unwanted,
they cannot be entirely avoided.
